versions.changelog:
Initial release of ClawFeed news digest tool.

- Generates structured news digests (4-hourly, daily, weekly, monthly) from Twitter and RSS feeds.
- API server supports viewing digests, bookmarks, feeds, and user authentication (Google OAuth).
- Runs in read-only mode by default; authentication enables personal features like bookmarks.
- Uses SQLite (bundled, no external DB needed).
- Includes web dashboard and customizable templates for curation and summarization.
- Simple environment configuration and reverse proxy setup instructions provided.
